Handbook of Social Psychology. Fails rule 1: fertility control is not the behaviour at issue. A bridge only because the stigma canon cites general stigma theory through it - this is the citation-structure analogue of the 148-record HIV-stigma contamination in scope section 8.

BORDERLINE and bears on PI call 5. Weekly longitudinal panel, religiosity and young unmarried Christian women's contraceptive and condom use. Rule 5 fires before rule 7: religiosity is a value, and wall 5 gives values to D.1.a. If Anup rules religious objection to A.6 this becomes LINK_NORM_USE and is the best-designed record found so far.
